brief:
Shehab Wire reported that a Gaza security unit called "Raded," affiliated with resistance security forces, has documented initial testimonies from escapees of a camp run by gangs cooperating with Israeli occupation. The testimonies, collected on August 22, 2026, describe serious violations and torture inside the facility located in Gaza's "yellow line" area.

The escaped detainees provided accounts detailing systematic abuses within the camp operated by gangs aligned with the occupation. The Raded unit, part of the resistance security apparatus in Gaza, is investigating the allegations and processing the witness statements as part of its ongoing security operations against collaborationist networks.
